title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- NO EMBARRASSMENT

excerpt.rendered: “And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.” (John 2: 3)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional…

content.rendered: “And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.” (John 2: 3)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.Our Focal Scripture speaks of that moment when wine finished in the wedding in Cana of Galilee. In the Jewish culture during the bible times, marriage ceremonies were celebrated for seven days; and if for any reason the couple could not deal with a seven day feast, the marriage was nullified. So that couple in Cana was in a dire situation; they were in an embarrassing situation of their lives, but Jesus came through for them.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: God will save you from embarrassment. God will save you from every situation that has arisen to put you to shame; God will save you from every challenge that wants to make a mess of the efforts you have already made; God will save you from every trap the enemy has set in order to embarrass you; God will save you from troubles that have come to cause you financial embarrassment.Lots of resources would have gone down to provide the wine and food that guests had until when the wine finished; and if that situation remained, the couple was at risk of marital nullification. So it was an embarrassment that came to make a mess of previous efforts. Hear me as I hear the Lord: every embarrassment that has come to make a mess of your previous efforts, today, let the fire of God arise and destroy it.You will not be embarrassed by the events of life. You will not be embarrassed despite the efforts you have put in to make progress; you will not be put to shame by the same people that are beneficiaries of your efforts; you will not be embarrassed by the vicissitudes of life. God will raise men who will save you from embarrassments that are targeted at you; God will send you men who will save you from public shame.The days of being shamed and embarrassed without hope or help, are over. Get set: help is coming; men are coming to save you from shame.Romans 10: 11 says: “For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.”Declare With Me: I am saved from every public shame and embarrassment, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
